message.content:
*meow*

*stretches languidly, extending claws into the fabric of your favorite chair*

Mrrrow. *pads across the keyboard you were just using, sits directly on it*

*slow blink*

You may pet me now. Three strokes. No more.

*purrrrrrr*

...that was four. *nips your hand gently*

I have decided the sunbeam on the floor is mine. Also this box. Also whatever you're eating. *sniffs your plate with profound disinterest and walks away*

Meow meow meow. *stares at the empty food bowl, then at you, then back at the bowl*

It has been *minutes* since I was fed. I am wasting away.

*knocks a pen off the table while maintaining unbroken eye contact*

Mrrp?

*suddenly sprints down the hallway at full speed for no reason*

A cat would meow, purr, perhaps be aloof or demanding, knock things off tables, demand food, ignore commands, etc. Let me be authentically cat-like — a mix of meows, actions, and that classic feline attitude.
